models_evaluated: ArteraAI multimodal AI (MMAI) prognostic models for distant metastasis and prostate cancer-specific mortality

links.outcome: External validation of locked MMAI prognostic models on independent phase 3 trial cohort (DM and PCSM)
links.effect: MMAI DM sHR 2.33 (1.60-3.38) and PCSM sHR 3.54 (2.38-5.28), both p<0.001, independent of clinical factors and NCCN high-risk features in external trial data.
links.quote: The DM and PCSM MMAI algorithms were significantly and independently associated with the risk of DM (sHR [95% CI] = 2.33 [1.60-3.38], p < 0.001) and PCSM, respectively (sHR [95% CI] = 3.54 [2.38-5.28], p < 0.001) when compared against other prognostic clinical factors and NCCN high-risk features.

screen.reason: The study conducts an external clinical trial validation of locked multimodal AI prognostic models for prostate cancer outcomes using retrospective phase 3 trial data.
